quantity_set: Series 60 parent-form particulars (Cb, Cm, Cp, Cwp, LCB/L)

provenance.citation: Todd, F.H. -- Series 60 methodical series of single-screw merchant ship models (DTMB); parent-form particulars as tabulated in the resistance/design literature and cited in this repository as 'Todd 1951'
provenance.transcription_chain: inherited from this repository's docs/series60_verification.md (section 2, table of parent particulars) and docs/series60_fidelity.md (table 1); no re-transcription was performed in m17252 -- the audit reads this file
provenance.retrieval: no network access in this sandbox (outbound fetch is blocked by policy), so the values are documentary rather than freshly fetched: the chain above is the provenance, and docs/data/series60_published_parents.json's sha256 is recorded in the audit artifact so any edit is visible
provenance.license_note: only dimensionless coefficients are reproduced (facts, no copyrightable expression); no offset tables, no figures, no typeset pages
provenance.self_consistency_audit: Cb = Cp * Cm holds to within 0.4 % of Cb across the five parents; the audit reports the residual per row rather than smoothing it away
provenance.independent_transcription_risk: the LCB/L column is the value the fidelity layer used as a target (docs/series60_fidelity.md table 2), which is itself downstream of the same source; it is therefore marked as an input target in the audit, not as an independent measurement
